title: XII–XVI: sex; male and female; first parents Adam and Eve
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Eve ye first woman constructed out from ye rib belonging toward Adam — Adam was ye first man divinely formed. XVI. Ye first parents are ye first humans. XV. Sex shines forth both in ye first parents plus in descendants. XIV. plus verses 21-22 ye Lord God caused Adam to sleep with deepest sleep plus drew out one out from ye ribs plus constructed ye woman out from that rib. I will make toward him a help that is before him — Genesis 2:18 — And Moses: It is not good that ye human be alone. Have you not read that ye Maker from ye beginning made male plus female — Matthew 19:4 — on which account Christ praising Moses text says. unless he also have ye other portion belonging toward himself — therefore since ye male alone cannot generate he is not altogether judged perfect toward ye consummation belonging toward his genus. when it can generate ye like belonging toward itself — for each being is then called perfect in physics. This difference belonging toward sex is necessary toward generation plus thus toward ye perfection belonging toward ye human genus. XIII. Plus humankind according toward sex is male plus female. by which distinguished by ye organs belonging toward generation he furnishes origin toward his descendants — there follows sex. XII. These things concerning ye essential parts belonging toward humankind.
pass_b_english: XII. So much concerning the essential parts of humankind: there follows sex, by which, distinguished by the organs of generation, he furnishes origin to his descendants. XIII. And humankind according to sex is male and female. This difference of sex is necessary for generation, and so for the perfection of the human race. For each being is then called perfect in physics when it can generate its like. Therefore, since the male alone cannot generate, he is not altogether judged perfect for the consummation of his genus unless he also have the other portion of himself. On that account Christ in Matthew 19:4, praising Moses' text, says: Have you not read that the Maker from the beginning made male and female? And Moses in Genesis 2:18: It is not good that the human be alone; I will make him a help that is before him. And in verses 21–22 the Lord God caused Adam to sleep with deepest sleep, drew out one of the ribs, and constructed the woman from that rib.

XIV. Sex shines forth both in the first parents and in their descendants. XV. The first parents are the first humans. XVI. Adam was the first man, divinely formed; Eve the first woman, constructed from Adam's rib.
source_text: XII. Haec de partibus hominis essentialibus: sequitur sexus, quo organis generationis discretus posteris suis originem praebet. XIII. Estque homo secundum sexum mas et femina. Haec differentia sexus necessaria est generationi, adeoque ad perfectionem humani generis. Unumquodque enim ens tunc perfectum dicitur in physicis, cum sibi simile generare potest. Quare cum solus mas generare nequeat, non omnino perfectus censetur ad consummationem sui generis, nisi et alteram sui portionem habeat. Eapropter Christus Matth. XIX.4 laudans textum Mosis ait: Non legistis opificem ab initio fecisse masculum et feminam. Et Moses Gen. II.18: Non est bonum hominem esse solum; faciam ei adjumentum quod sit coram eo. Et v.21–22 Dominus Deus arctissimo sopore consopivit Adamum et ex costis unam detraxit et construxit Deus ex ea costa mulierem. XIV. Sexus elucet tum in primis parentibus tum in posteris. XV. Primi parentes sunt primi homines. XVI. Adamus fuit primus vir, divinitus formatus; Eva prima femina e costa Adami constructa.
